title: Local finite presentation comparison maps
statement: Let X be a ringed space, F a finitely presented module, and psi: O_X^r -> F an epimorphism. For each point x there is a neighborhood U, a finite presentation P of F restricted to U, a map psi-prime from O_U^r to F restricted to U, and comparison maps alpha and beta satisfying alpha followed by P.generators.pi = psi-prime and beta followed by psi-prime = P.generators.pi. The restriction of kernel psi is isomorphic to kernel psi-prime.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BP(1), proof first paragraph; kernels: Section 01AF

proof.text: Choose quasicoherent data from SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData. Opens.coversTop_iff and Opens.mem_iSup choose a cover member U containing x, with its finite presentation P. Restrict psi to U and precompose with mapFreeIso to obtain the epimorphism psiU.

The proved private local_free_lifts applies on the localized site Over U. Forgetting modules to abelian sheaves preserves epimorphisms. Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' supplies covering image sieves for the images of every basis element of psiU and P.generators.pi. GrothendieckTopology.iInf_mem intersects each finite family; intersection_covering intersects the two families. mem_over_iff and Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology choose V containing x with V -> U in the common sieve. Restrict each chosen section lift to every object of Over V, and extend the resulting compatible sections by freeHomEquiv.symm. Naturality and the original section equations show the two map equations after applying freeHomEquiv. Empty index types have top covering sieve.

Map the presentation along overMap R i and transport it by overFunctorMap R i. Presentation.isFinite_map and the finite presentation isomorphism instance preserve finiteness. Define psiV using the free-module comparison er and restriction of psiU; define alpha = a followed by eg.inv and beta = b followed by er.inv. Presentation.map_pi_eq and GeneratingSections.ofEpi_pi identify the transported generator map. Associativity and inverse-hom cancellation prove both comparison equations.

The composite er, the image of the original free restriction isomorphism, and overFunctorMap gives an isomorphism eV from the free module on V to the restriction of the original free module. Naturality identifies psiV with eV.hom followed by the restriction of psi. Compose PreservesKernel.iso for restriction, inverse kernelIsIsoComp for eV.hom, and kernelIsoOfEq to obtain the stated kernel isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Lemma 01BP(1), proof first paragraph; Section 01AF for kernels. Implemented using localized covering image sieves and Mathlib presentation and kernel transport.

lean.statement: theorem finitePresentation_local_comparison (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (r : ℕ) (ψ : SheafOfModules.free (R := moduleRings X) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ⟶ F) (hψ : Epi ψ) (x : X) : ∃ (U : Opens X), x ∈ U ∧ ∃ (ψ' : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ⟶ F.over U) (P : (F.over U).Presentation), P.IsFinite ∧ ∃ (α : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ⟶ SheafOfModules.free P.generators.I) (β : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) P.generators.I ⟶ SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r))), α ≫ P.generators.π = ψ' ∧ β ≫ ψ' = P.generators.π ∧ Nonempty ((kernel ψ).over U ≅ kernel ψ')
